run_pipeline: run the pipeline configuration and print the resulting module configuration dictionary
configure_pipeline: configure a data processing pipeline with loader, preprocess, algorithm, and formatter modules
refactor_configure_pipeline: refactor configure_pipeline to return a different initial guess for the four pipeline modules
test_run_pipeline: test the run_pipeline function to verify it returns a valid configuration dictionary
summarize_configure_pipeline: summarize the configure_pipeline function and its available module options for each pipeline stage
